title: Team building activities in KL
excerpt: Team days in KL are art, baking, or a mix of the two, at the Desa Sri Hartamas studio. Public workshops also include candle making and chunky crochet.
seo_description: Team building activities in KL: art and baking days in Desa Sri Hartamas from RM1,200. Public workshops also include candle making and crochet.
cover_alt: Adults painting canvases together at a Master Artist workshop
author: Master Artist
body_html:
Team building activities in KL at Master Artist are a private art day or a baking day at the studio in Desa Sri Hartamas. You paint or bake together, and each person takes something home the same day. Candle making and chunky crochet are public workshops. You book those as a single seat, not as a team-day stream. Current dates are on the workshops page.

Team building activities in KL

An art team day is painting. A baking team day is Bake Lab. A mixed day runs art and baking side by side. Each workshop is two hours. A drink and all materials are included.

If you searched for a sip and paint, a painting workshop is that evening: one guided canvas, with a drink included.

  • Acrylic canvas is RM89, or RM160 for a pair. One brush-on canvas from a guided theme. Up to 18 seats, in the L2 front room.
  • Textured and impasto canvas is RM89, or RM160 for a pair. One canvas with texture paste or thick paint and palette knives. Up to 20 seats, in the L2 front room.
  • Glow-in-the-dark canvas is RM85, or RM153 for a pair. One canvas in glow acrylics. Up to 18 seats, in the L2 front room.
  • Watercolour is RM80, or RM144 for a pair. One painting on cotton paper. Up to 20 seats, in the L2 front room.
  • Bake Lab is RM95, or RM171 for a pair. Specialty breads and cakes are RM85. One bake, boxed to take home. Up to 24 seats, or 20 for a specialty bake, in the L1 kitchen.

Two more public workshops. These are single seats, not a team day.

  • Candle making is RM89, or RM160 for a pair. You pour, scent and decorate candles in gift-ready jars, and take them home boxed. Up to 16 seats.
  • Chunky crochet is RM95, or RM171 for a pair. You learn the basic stitches and leave with a small bag. No experience needed. Up to 20 seats.

What a seat includes

The price includes a drink and all the materials. Please arrive 15 minutes early.

Seats are prepaid. We confirm on WhatsApp and send payment details there. Each session needs a minimum of six people. If it does not reach six, we message you and offer another date.

You can add a meal at Savor downstairs, from RM25. The prices on the workshop pages are Launch Season prices, until 30 April 2027. A public holiday session is 10% more.

A private team day

Book a team day on the groups page. An art team day is RM1,200 for up to 10 people. A baking team day is RM1,700 for up to 15. A mixed day, art and baking side by side, is RM2,400 for up to 20. Each extra person is RM100. The price includes materials and a teacher for each stream. Team days run from 6 people. A dinner and evening workshop is RM150 a person, from 10 people.

Tell us the package, the numbers and a date. We confirm on WhatsApp, and seats are prepaid. A birthday is a different booking. Use the birthdays page for that.

Team building near me in KL

The studio is upstairs, above Savor, at 38-2, Jalan 28/70A, Desa Sri Hartamas, 50480 Kuala Lumpur. Hours are Sunday 10am–6pm, Monday to Thursday 10am–10pm, and Friday 10am–5pm. Saturday is closed. On Fridays there are no workshops after 12:30pm. On Sundays there are no workshops before 12pm.

For a public seat, start on the workshops page. You can also WhatsApp +60 10-277 9426 or email info@masterartist.co. For a private team, use the groups page.

Frequently asked questions

What team building activities can we do in KL?

A team day in KL is art, baking, or a mix of the two. Art is a painting workshop. Baking is Bake Lab. Candle making and chunky crochet are public workshops, booked as single seats, not as a team-day stream. Each workshop is two hours, with a drink and all materials, and you take the piece home.

How much does a team day cost?

An art team day is RM1,200 for up to 10 people. A baking team day is RM1,700 for up to 15. A mixed day, art and baking side by side, is RM2,400 for up to 20. Each extra person is RM100. The price includes materials and a teacher for each stream.

How many people can come?

Team days run from 6 people. Art covers up to 10, baking up to 15, and a mixed day up to 20. Each extra person is RM100. A dinner and evening workshop is RM150 a person, from 10 people. Candle making and crochet are public seats, with their own caps, and they are not part of a team day.

Where is team building near me in KL?

The studio is upstairs, above Savor, at 38-2, Jalan 28/70A, Desa Sri Hartamas, 50480 Kuala Lumpur, a short drive from Mont Kiara. Saturday is closed. Friday workshops finish by 12:30pm. Sunday workshops do not start before 12pm. Current dates are on the workshops page.

For a team day, tell us art, baking or mixed on the groups page. For one seat, including candle making or crochet, use the workshops page. We confirm on WhatsApp.
